why: Style is transferred to the image model as PIXELS, not adjectives. A prose STYLE_SUFFIX does not survive a model generation change (2.5 -> 3.1), which is exactly how this folder came to exist. Every ref here is a cover that is LIVE in the app, so new covers are anchored to the real catalog look.
chosen: These three are the most consistent expression of the house style: desaturated charcoal-navy ground, flat vector, subject anchored in the bottom third with the top two thirds nearly empty, a single warm amber light as the focal accent, and a muted sage secondary. The ikea-effect cover was deliberately EXCLUDED: it is light, warm and near-3D, the outlier of the catalog, and would teach the model the wrong thing.
refresh: To refresh a ref, copy the file from learning-drops/inbox/<slug>/cover.webp (or the public bucket at /storage/v1/object/public/learning-media/<slug>/cover.webp) and update the entry below. Keep the count at 3: Gemini 3.x flash accepts up to 3 style reference images.

refs.note: Two figures, doorway light. The cleanest example of the bottom-anchored composition.
Curtain and nightstand. Carries the sage secondary and the thin amber edge light.
Bottles on a shelf. Single glowing focal object against a dead-empty upper field.

Brand palette only (navy tile, violet rings, gold path). OFF by default: no house cover contains a mark, and feeding a logo as a style ref is the shortest path to it being stamped into the art. Enable with CONTENT_MEDIA_STYLE_GLYPH=on.
